$comment: Generated from the ADR files; consistency is enforced by tools/validate_adr_index. Update whenever an ADR or amendment lands: `amendments` counts the `### Amendment ` headings in docs/adr/history/ADR-NNN-amendments.md, which must equal the ADR's amendment-log table rows. Amendment notes never live in the main ADR file. This project does not categorize ADRs, so there are no cluster or pillar fields.

adrs.title: Decision governance for humans and coding agents
The website exists to sell and to keep customers successful
Redesign the experience; do not reproduce WordPress 1:1
SEO-first multilingual information architecture under locale paths
Astro owns routing; static-first; React only for bounded islands
Cloudflare is the production target for site, media and video
Local Git is source of truth; deployment is explicit
Editorial voice must demonstrate engineering mastery
Separate prospect, customer-support and partner journeys
Keep SQL/auth/license/download integrations behind explicit boundaries
Prefer real PCam media; migrate with provenance and hash deduplication
Performance, accessibility and responsive behavior are baseline requirements
